added.summary: `filter(<image>, <filter functions>)` (Filter Effects 1 §12) is an image wherever a background, mask or border image takes one: `filter(url(a.png), grayscale(1) blur(2px))` draws the image through the same functions the `filter` property takes, in order, without filtering the element. It works inside `cross-fade()`, and a `filter()` of a `filter()` applies both lists. `url(#id)` references are refused.
